Authority of the Inquisition: Every model in the army with access to the Armory may select a single item from any Imperial faction.

Designer's note: The Inquisition has access to a limited range of units and is best fielded as an allied detachment. The ally chart is intentionally broad, allowing for all kinds of Inquisitorial forces: From strict puritans to dangerous radicals. While most armies may ally with the Inquisition, certain factions have natural access to its forces as part of their extended army list. Adeptus Sororitas, Grey Knights and Space Marine armies (with the Chamber Militant Archetypes) may include Inquisition units as if they were part of their own army.
